problem.description: Three incidents in three nights (INC0010001-INC0010003) with the same duplicate key error during the nightly load into the reporting warehouse.
problem.cause_notes: The source system re-sends late-arriving orders, so the same order_id appears twice in one batch. The load has no dedup step, so the MERGE hits the unique constraint on order_id.
problem.workaround: Delete the duplicate rows from the staging table and rerun the nightly load manually.
problem.fix_notes: Permanent fix delivered by CHG0030002: ROW_NUMBER() dedup on order_id added to the staging step before the MERGE.

change.description: Permanent fix for PRB0040001 (recurring nightly load failure).
change.justification: Permanent fix for the recurring nightly load failure (PRB0040001). Stops duplicate key errors and stale morning reports.
change.implementation_plan: Add a ROW_NUMBER() dedup on order_id in the staging step, keeping the latest record by load timestamp, before the MERGE into the warehouse.
change.backout_plan: Revert to the previous version of the load script.
change.test_plan: Run the load against a staging batch with known duplicate order_ids and confirm it completes with no constraint errors.
change.risk_impact_analysis: Low risk: change is limited to the staging step of one nightly job.
change.close_notes: Dedup step deployed to the nightly load. Test batch with duplicate order_ids loaded with no constraint errors; first production run completed successfully.
